sentences.text: दादी का गाँव बहुत छोटा है।
sentences.english: Grandma's village is very small.
There are many trees in the village.
There is a river in the village.
There are fields near the river.

sentences.text: दादी का घर भी छोटा है।
sentences.english: Grandma's house is small too.
The roof of the house is small.
There are some flowers on the roof.

sentences.text: घर में एक बड़ा आँगन है।
sentences.english: The house has a big courtyard.

sentences.text: आँगन में आम का पेड़ है।
sentences.english: There is a mango tree in the courtyard.
There are many mangoes on the tree.

sentences.text: आँगन में एक गाय भी है।
sentences.english: There is a cow in the courtyard too.

sentences.text: दादी रोज़ गाय को पानी देती हैं।
sentences.english: Grandma gives the cow water every day.

sentences.text: गाँव में राजू और सीता रहते हैं।
sentences.english: Raju and Sita live in the village.
Raju is Sita's brother.
Sita is Raju's sister.

sentences.text: राजू और सीता दादी के घर के पास रहते हैं।
sentences.english: Raju and Sita live near Grandma's house.

sentences.text: राजू और सीता रवि और मीरा के दोस्त हैं।
sentences.english: Raju and Sita are friends of Ravi and Mira.

sentences.text: राजू रवि को आम देता है।
sentences.english: Raju gives Ravi a mango.
The mangoes are very sweet.

sentences.text: सीता मीरा को पानी देती है।
sentences.english: Sita gives Mira water.
Moti looks at the cow.
The cow looks at Moti.

sentences.text: मोती गाय से दूर बैठता है।
sentences.english: Moti sits far from the cow.

sentences.text: कल रवि और मीरा गाँव में थे।
sentences.english: Yesterday Ravi and Mira were in the village.
Grandma was in the village too.
Raju was in the courtyard.
Sita was near the river.
Moti was in the village too.
Everything in the village was good.
